name: Room and equipment booking
description: Lists room and equipment mailboxes with their booking settings: automatic processing, conflicts, recurring meetings, booking window, maximum duration, who may book and resource delegates.

parameters.name: Mailbox
parameters.label: Rooms or equipment
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases. Leave blank to list every room and equipment mailbox up to the limit.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes
parameters.help: Stops after this many mailboxes and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Booking settings need one read per mailbox, so large tenants take a while.
Resource delegates are shown exactly as Exchange returns them and are not resolved to accounts.
Book-in and request-in policy lists other than All are not shown.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
